advancements.elysiumenchanting.arcane_ta: Build an Arcane Table. It asks the room how much power it has, how uncertain it is, how strange it is, and how much of the uncertainty has been paid off
advancements.elysiumenchanting.deep_work: Spend thirty levels on a single enchantment
advancements.elysiumenchanting.grand_scr: Build a Grand Scriptorium: sixty-four times the shelf, which is what makes the highest levels bankable
advancements.elysiumenchanting.infusion_: Build an Infusion Basin. The book says what you get, the room says how high, and the price is the certainty
advancements.elysiumenchanting.root.desc: Enchanting is a room you build, not a table you stand at
advancements.elysiumenchanting.scriptori: Build a Scriptorium, and the chest of books you were never going to use becomes a currency
advancements.elysiumenchanting.steady_ro: Make a Keeper's Shelf. Rectification is the hardest of the four to raise, and it is what keeps the upside of an uncertain table
advancements.elysiumenchanting.strange_r: Make a Sightshelf. Arcana does not make an enchantment stronger — it changes which ones are on the table at all
advancements.elysiumenchanting.tome.desc: Make a Tome of Patience. An anvil that will not touch your best pickaxe at any price is a wall, and this is the way through it
elysiumenchanting.infusion.conflict: It argues with what is already there
elysiumenchanting.infusion.nothing: A book, and something to put it on
elysiumenchanting.infusion.too_rare: This room is not strange enough
elysiumenchanting.library.empty: Not enough filed for a copy
elysiumenchanting.shelf.archive_column: everything, in order, and none of it is interesting

elysiumenchanting.shelf.enchanting_table: the old table, which is a component rather than a competitor

elysiumenchanting.shelf.endshelf: written somewhere that has no weather

elysiumenchanting.tooltip.concentration_: On an anvil: narrows a mixed book down to its best line
elysiumenchanting.tooltip.patience_tome: On an anvil: clears what an item's history is costing, once
elysiumenchanting.tooltip.scrapping_tome: On an anvil: takes every enchantment off, so a table will look at it again
elysiumenchanting.tooltip.transcription_: On an anvil: moves everything onto a book, and the item is spent doing it
enchantment.elysiumenchanting.ambush.des: more from a blow nobody saw coming
enchantment.elysiumenchanting.bulwark.de: armour for a player who has decided to stand still

a crust over the lava, and it will not hold long

further, harder, and still in the rain
armour that is worth more where you cannot see

a blow that makes the next one land harder
enchantment.elysiumenchanting.thrift.des: the arrow you sometimes still have

enchantment.elysiumenchanting.volley.des: more arrows, and less idea where they are going
